notes.title: Why not try out Mobocratic Union Beta Branch?
notes.content:
Happy new year to all our original mobocrats (be proud of that, did you know you're a trendsetter?),

Today, we're glad to announce the newest the Mobocratic Union January Update, which includes many new, intriguing new features. Let's take a look, shall we?

[list]
[*] New background graphics for the MEPs office, news studio and country page
[*] UI improvements: verbalized and visualized ideological descriptions of policy proposals and visualization of relative influence between characters
[*] Inbuilt Mobopedia with articles on how to play the game and explanations on how the different systems in the game work
[*] Some easter eggs... As Aristotle said: "Those who know, know." Others, let's figure out!
[*] A system for activating and inactivating amendments based on thematic amendment packs
[*] Several bug fixes
[/list]
Let's wishlist Mobocratic Union on Steam today:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2603680/Mobocratic_Union/

notes.title: Mobocratic September Update
notes.content:
[b]After a longer pause, a new Mobocratic update is finally out![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37452995/006f2f296c4acfb9ae0ca96946ed999fa4dd3c1f.png[/img]

In this update the following are introduced:

[b]1)	Couples + romantic interests
2)	New policies
3)	Performance improvements
4)	Improved dictionaries
5)	New map[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37452995/2904eab2787245379bad154fdd93db140e67e0a9.png[/img]

Take your game to the next level and explore the new things you can do as the President of Bear Island.  Or maybe, Temptation Island? 😎

Rule with new policies and try to achieve a balance of ideology, economics and votes. Play with the new, bigger and better map which gives room for creativity!

notes.title: Mobocratic Summer Update
notes.content:
[b]Mobocratic Summer Update [/b]brings in a totally new event - [b]Presidential Elections![/b] Now, if the citizens are fed up with your rule, they can run for [b]YOUR[/b] office and make change happen! Don't let this happen!

The new update also brings with it new tools for the organization of the governmental machine. Tools within the constraints of law, of course. Now the President has the possibility of creating an [b]electoral reform[/b]. For everything to go by the rules, this he [b]needs to have the support of the supreme court of Bear Island[/b]. This is no banana state, after all!

[previewyoutube=3F1hzUrBFTY;full][/previewyoutube]

Within the reform it's possible to [b]redraw election districts[/b] and [b]rebalance the amount of seats gained from each district[/b]. This, of course, to make sure everyone on the island gets their fair share of voting rights! Some less scrupulous statesmen might succumb to [b]gerrymandering[/b]. You surely wouldn't, right?

[previewyoutube=ChUW_SH_uE0;full][/previewyoutube]

As before, keep developing your island and keep making your citizens happy to keep your popularity! Give speeches - if you have the people on your side, talk about things that you value. If you're unpopular, pretend to like the things you hate and these will lose their traction in the populus!

When the election night finally arrives, you get to hear how well the citizens think you've done! They should be happy to have such a statesman and you should be awarded a direct ticket to your second term.

[previewyoutube=doh6ih3WbMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Unfortunately, the opposition is shrewd and unscrupulous in its tactics. They might have committed fraud so that it looks like you've lost! Fear not though, as there will be ways to negate the false results!

If you have exercised [b]discretion in picking the right candidates[/b] to the supreme court, you need not worry about an unfavourable electoral outcome! With the law by your side, the fake ballots cast by your opponents won't be putting your glorious tenure as the President to a premature end. You appeal to the court and justice will prevail!

If all else fails, you have your [b]Presidential Associates[/b] (some say, criminals - the thoughest people!) to make sure the really unfair election fraud by your opponents doesn't get its way! Send your associates to the streets to liberate the nation from under the frauds' rule!

The update brings with it a [b]streamlined and improved tutorial[/b] with more things covered. This should help you get started easier!

Gameplay of the tutorial:
[previewyoutube=Ppbvo2OXuu4;full][/previewyoutube]

Last but not least, the update has a minor graphics update   optimization. There's a new OST from Lusitanian Deviant Records. A bug reported to us regarding the save files has been fixed. There was a problem with ":" sign on the English language Windows, causing the game to crash. We're Finnish and we have different keyboard so this wasn't a problem in our testing. The problem with savegame crashing has been fixed!

[previewyoutube=bpGE5mtOux8;full][/previewyoutube]
